note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 272 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India: Isoptera. Original in English; the soldier and alate are described from type material and the worker from Bose's unpublished material; the three castes are available, nymphs are lacking; synonymic lists, bibliographic citations, figure numbers, distribution records and the description of wing microsculpture are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule oval, sides strongly narrowed anteriorly; labrum elongate ligulate, apex weakly spear-shaped and extending to slightly less than two-thirds of the mandibles; mandibles slender, apex slightly incurved; postmentum subrectangular, slightly longer than wide; alate head capsule subcircular, Y-suture weak, compound eyes strongly protruding, ocelli touching the compound eye or almost so; worker dimorphic.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, paler at the middle; labrum of the same pale yellowish brown; antennae, legs and abdomen milk white. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.70–3.90 mm. Head capsule oval (to mandible base 0.88–0.93 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.85 mm, width/length ratio 0.892–0.909); sides strongly narrowed anteriorly (width at mandible base 0.50–0.58 mm, constriction index 0.625–0.682). Antennae 14-segmented; 3rd segment shortest. Labrum elongate ligulate, apex weakly spear-shaped, extending to slightly less than two-thirds of the mandibles (length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.18–0.23 mm). Mandibles slender, outer margin slightly concave in the basal half; apex slightly incurved (length 0.50–0.53 mm, mandible length/head length ratio 0.569). Postmentum subrectangular, slightly longer than wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin not wavy (length 0.33–0.35 mm, width 0.54–0.55 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale cream yellow; postclypeus and labrum concolorous; antennae, legs and abdomen pale cream white. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 4.0–4.3 mm. Head subsquare (to mandible base 0.93–0.95 mm, width 0.90 mm). Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus convex, about half as long as wide (length 0.15–0.20 mm, width 0.40–0.43 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.26–0.28 mm, width 0.46–0.58 mm). Minor worker: generally smaller, head capsule subcircular, otherwise as in the major worker; body length 3.5 mm, head length to mandible base 0.60–0.63 mm, maximum head width 0.73–0.75 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae, postclypeus and legs yellow; anterior part of the pronotum yellowish brown, posterior part paler, with a pale yellow T-shaped mark at the middle and rounded humeral spots on each side; mesonotum and metanotum paler than the pronotum, each with a pair of yellow spots posteriorly; dorsal abdomen yellowish brown, ventral abdomen pale yellow. Head and pronotum moderately pilose, abdomen densely pilose. Body length with wings 15.0–18.0 mm, without wings 8.5–11.10 mm. Head capsule subcircular (to mandible base 1.05–1.13 mm, width including compound eyes 1.43–1.65 mm); slightly depressed around the fontanelle, raised between the compound eyes; Y-suture weak. Fontanelle minute, circular, white, punctiform. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.43–0.50 mm), strongly protruding. Ocelli medium-sized (long diameter 0.23–0.27 mm, short diameter 0.16–0.18 mm); touching the compound eye or separated by only 0.01–0.02 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, occasionally 16-segmented; 3rd segment shortest (in 16-segmented individuals the 3rd segment is longer than the 4th). Postclypeus strongly convex; length slightly more than half its width; anterior margin straight, posterior margin strongly convex and slightly produced at the middle. Pronotum almost semicircular (length 0.85–0.93 mm, width 1.25–1.45 mm); anterior margin slightly concave, with a weak median emargination; posterior margin slightly convex, slightly incurved at the middle. Fore wing length 12.75–13.6 mm, hind wing length 12.0–13.2 mm.
